# hyperfluid_agent_slack_manifest (Data Source)

The Slack app manifest for an agent: paste it in Slack's "Create an app from a manifest" to create the app whose bot and app-level tokens `hyperfluid_agent_slack_channel` references. It holds no secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Paste the manifest in Slack's "Create an app from a manifest", then store the
# app's bot token and app-level token as plaintext secrets.
data "hyperfluid_agent_slack_manifest" "support" {
  agent_id = hyperfluid_agent.support.id
}

output "slack_manifest" {
  value = data.hyperfluid_agent_slack_manifest.support.manifest
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Id of the `hyperfluid_agent`.

### Read-Only

- `app_token_scope` (String) The scope to give the app-level token (`connections:write`).
- `manifest` (String) The manifest, YAML, named after the agent.
- `notes` (List of String) What to know when creating the app.
